recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core source follow-up is needed unless a future work group explicitly decides to reintroduce an authenticator element separate from attester.
issue_request: FHIR-25087 requested changing DocumentReference.authenticator from 0..1 to support multiple signers/co-signers, with final Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution to align with Composition.attester by bringing in the whole attester backbone and sub-elements.
initial_application: No Jira-tagged source commit for FHIR-25087 was found. Historical R4-era source had DocumentReference.authenticator as a 0..1 Reference, while the R5 source rework introduced DocumentReference.attester as a 0..* BackboneElement with mode, time, and party sub-elements.
additional_context: FHIR-34160 later resolved the same authenticator/attester ambiguity by changing the attester definition to say authenticated accuracy rather than restoring authenticator. FHIR-36751 later asked again for authenticator 0..* and was resolved no-change because R5 attester already has 0..* cardinality; that issue is already audited on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/fhir.ini keeps DocumentReference in build scope and maps DocumentReference.authenticator to DocumentReference.attester; current DocumentReference and Composition StructureDefinitions already show the requested 0..* attester backbone alignment.
